one_liner: Close is a CRM with a broad REST API, OAuth 2.0 and API keys, webhooks, and an official MCP server. Credentials need a Close org, and the pages show no free plan. Free secondary orgs and Dev orgs exist, and the trial is unverified here.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 is self-serve through app creation, which gives a Client ID and Secret, and the docs strongly recommend it for multi-user integrations. API keys are generated in Settings > Developer > API Keys and tied to a user. BASIC is retained from the draft because the API-key scheme page was not in the fetched text. Access level (read-only or read/write/delete) is configurable per key.
access_notes: The fetched pages say nothing about a free plan or a trial. A Close org is needed to generate API keys or an OAuth app. Existing Close users can create a free secondary organization. Non-users who are integration partners can request a free Dev organization from support, which is a manual step. The OAuth app keeps working if the subscription lapses. The 14-day trial claim in the draft came from pages not provided, so it is unverified here.
blocker_notes: A Close organization is required. The pages confirm free secondary orgs for existing users and free Dev orgs by emailing support, but not a self-serve free tier or trial. The paid-plan or trial path is unverified from these pages.
